how_to_use: Paste the text of one prompt into each tool, exactly as written, in a fresh project or chat.
Take the first output. No regeneration, no follow-up message, no edits.
If the tool fails or asks a question, record that and answer only 'continue'. Grade whatever exists.
Record the tool, plan, model name if the tool shows one, and the date and time.

prompts.text: Design a landing page for a small independent coffee roaster that sells beans by subscription. It should feel warm and a bit premium, and it needs a clear way to start a subscription.
Build a dashboard for a freelance invoicing tool. Show money owed, money received this month, overdue invoices and a list of recent clients.
Create a product page for a pair of handmade leather boots, with photos, sizes, price, delivery information and customer reviews.
Make a pricing page for a project management app with three plans and a comparison of what each plan includes.
Make a portfolio website for a freelance illustrator who works on children's books. Show selected projects, a short about section and a way to get in touch.
Design an article page for a long magazine feature about the restoration of an old lighthouse. Include the title, a byline, a pull quote, images and links to related stories.
